findings.current: its sheer scale couldn’t compare to anyone I’d fought so far.
findings.defect: “Couldn’t compare” suggests Michael’s power falls short; the source says its magnitude is beyond comparison with past opponents.
findings.rationale: 누구와도 비교할 수 없었다 describes an unmatched magnitude, not an inferior one.
findings.replacement: its sheer scale was beyond anything I’d faced before.
findings.source: 그 기운의 크기만큼은 지금껏 싸워 왔던 누구와도 비교할 수 없었다.

findings.current: A monster that had spent decades building up its power right under the nose of an absolute being stood before me.
findings.defect: “Right under the nose” replaces Michael’s deliberate evasion of that being’s notice with mere proximity.
findings.rationale: 눈을 피해 means avoiding someone’s watch or notice.
findings.replacement: A monster that had spent decades building up its power while evading the notice of an absolute being stood before me.
findings.source: 어느 절대자의 눈을 피해 장장 수십여 년간 힘을 축적해 온 괴물이 바로 눈앞에 있었다.

findings.current: Chuck Hagel spat out a glob of phlegm, looking as if the nicotine had brought him back to life.
findings.defect: The draft presents Hagel’s revived appearance as an observation rather than his pretense.
findings.rationale: 척 explicitly marks the revival as something he is putting on.
findings.replacement: Chuck Hagel spat out a glob of phlegm, pretending the nicotine had brought him back to life.
findings.source: 니코틴 보충으로 생기를 되찾은 척 헤이글이 가래를 탁 뱉었다.

findings.current: “Even the shortest of our relationships is over ten years old. I’ve grown quite fond of you all. Haven’t you?”
findings.defect: “Grown quite fond” turns Michael’s claim of long familiarity into an assertion of affection.
findings.rationale: 친숙하게 느껴지는군 conveys familiarity; the appeal to friendship comes in his next speech.
findings.replacement: “Even the shortest of our relationships goes back more than ten years. You all feel like old acquaintances to me. Don’t I to you?”
findings.source: 이중 가장 짧은 인연을 따져도 10년을 넘겼으니, 다들 친숙하게 느껴지는군. 자네들도 그렇지 않나?

findings.current: Behind the words *trust* and *friendship* lurked a shadow: ugly secrets only the people involved knew.
findings.defect: The draft identifies the secrets but omits that Michael is using them as leverage.
findings.rationale: 비밀을 빌미로 supplies the means of his coercion.
findings.replacement: Behind the words *trust* and *friendship* lurked a shadow: the ugly secrets only those involved knew, which Michael was using as leverage.
findings.source: 신뢰와 우정이라는 단어 뒤에 숨어 있는 그림자. 당사자들만이 아는 추악한 비밀을 빌미로.

findings.current: “Are you saying all of this happening now was your doing?”
findings.defect: “Your doing” suggests Jin personally carried out the attacks rather than that they happened by his decision.
findings.rationale: 자네의 뜻인가 asks whether the unfolding events reflect Jin’s will or intent.
findings.replacement: “Are you telling me everything happening right now is by your design?”
findings.source: 지금 벌어지는 이 모든 일이, 설마 자네의 뜻인가?

findings.current: But the next moment, another roar rose from every direction, like waves, smothering the sound.
findings.defect: The draft drops the screams that rise with the other crashes.
findings.rationale: 또 다른 굉음과 비명 explicitly includes both booming noises and screams.
findings.replacement: But the next moment, more crashes and screams surged in from every direction like waves, drowning it out.
findings.source: 하지만 이내 사방에서 파도처럼 밀려든 또 다른 굉음과 비명이 그 위를 뒤덮는다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it reverses two descriptions of Michael’s power and loses several cues in the confrontation.
